items.title_zh: 脑机接口法规情报追踪器
bullets_zh: 用于收集和可视化脑机接口相关法律与法规的 GitHub 工具。
提供采集器与界面，跟踪与脑机接口研究或产品相关的监管情报。
有助于监测非侵入式 BCI 合规动态，但本身不是审批公告。
bullets_en: GitHub tool for collecting and visualizing BCI-related legal and regulatory acts.
Provides a collector and UI to track regulatory intelligence relevant to BCI research or products.
Useful for monitoring the non-invasive BCI compliance landscape, though not an approval announcement itself.
